pr_title: [BugFix][Worker] Reset slot_mapping to pad id for dummy graph capture

rule.description: 在 `_dummy_run` 中重置 block table 的 slot_mapping 时，应仅在非 graph capture 场景下执行。在 graph capture 期间，slot_mapping 的值需要保持稳定，不应被重置为 -1。
checkpoints: 检查 `_dummy_run` 中是否有 `is_graph_capturing` 条件判断
确认 slot_mapping 重置是否在正确的场景下执行
注意变量名的准确性（`is_graph_capturing` 而非 `is_capturing`）

antipattern.code:
def _dummy_run(self, num_tokens: int) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
        """Run a dummy forward pass to capture the CUDA graph."""
        ...
        # Reset the slot mapping to -1 for all KV cache groups.
        # This ensures that stale slot_mapping values from previous runs
        # do not cause undefined behavior during graph capture.
        for kv_cache_gid in range(len(self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups)):
            blk_table = self.input_batch.block_table[kv_cache_gid]
            blk_table.slot_mapping.gpu.fill_(-1)

        # Run the model
        with self.maybe_setup_kv_cache(num_tokens):
            ...
            model_output = self.execute_model(
                execute_model_req,
                self.kv_cache_config,
            )
        ...
        return ModelRunnerOutput(
            req_ids=self.input_batch.req_ids,
            req_id_to_index=self.input_batch.req_id_to_index,
            sampled_token_ids=model_output.sampled_token_ids,
            logprobs=model_output.logprobs,
            prompt_logprobs_dict=model_output.prompt_logprobs_dict,
            pooler_output=model_output.pooler_output,
        )

def _dummy_run(self, num_tokens: int) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
        """Run a dummy forward pass to capture the CUDA graph."""
        ...
        # Reset the slot mapping to -1 for all KV cache groups.
        # Only do this when NOT capturing a graph, because during graph
        # capture the slot_mapping values must remain stable.
        if not is_graph_capturing:
            for kv_cache_gid in range(len(self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups)):
                blk_table = self.input_batch.block_table[kv_cache_gid]
                blk_table.slot_mapping.gpu.fill_(-1)

        # Run the model
        with self.maybe_setup_kv_cache(num_tokens):
            ...
            model_output = self.execute_model(
                execute_model_req,
                self.kv_cache_config,
            )
        ...
        return ModelRunnerOutput(
            req_ids=self.input_batch.req_ids,
            req_id_to_index=self.input_batch.req_id_to_index,
            sampled_token_ids=model_output.sampled_token_ids,
            logprobs=model_output.logprobs,
            prompt_logprobs_dict=model_output.prompt_logprobs_dict,
            pooler_output=model_output.pooler_output,
        )
